# mtncloud_forms (Data Source)

Lists your forms, including those made in the console. Forms collect inputs for workflows and catalog orders.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_forms" "all" {}

output "forms" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_forms.all.forms : x.id => { name = x.name, code = x.code } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return forms whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `forms` (Attributes List) The forms, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forms))

<a id="nestedatt--forms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forms`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Form code.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the form.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `name` (String) Name of the form.
